ai_review.summary: Fantastic matrix recording captures a smoking Other One → Cryptical Envelopment → Death Don't sequence with high‑energy playing.
ai_review.review: The FM broadcast delivers an excellent, clear mix that preserves the crowd ambience while presenting every nuance of the band’s performance. The show shines on the massive Other One > Cryptical > Death Don’t jam and a generally killer Lovelight despite a few misfired notes, with Jerry’s inspired guitar and Mickey & Bill’s fire‑on‑the‑drums synergy driving the energy sky‑high.

ai_rating.rationale: The review is glowing (5 stars) and highlights both an outstanding musical performance and a high‑quality matrix recording, warranting near‑top rating despite being based on a single detailed source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear FM broadcast sound with strong clarity; crowd ambience adds atmosphere but does not detract from the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Powerful second‑set jam sequence flows seamlessly; Lovelight slightly marred by a few misfires but remains strong overall.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Exceptionally inspired guitar work throughout, though he misfired a few times on the first solo in Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey and Bill were perfectly synchronized and on fire.
